Issue template tag Malware-ext-Ransomware-databreach, but sources describe data theft plus a ransom demand with no reported encryption or outage, so coded hacking Unknown + social Extortion (TEMPLATE DEPARTURE; some outlets call XP95 a 'ransomware group'). The $100k demand was refused - Alter behavior coded anyway per the skill. Stats SA confirmed the breached system was the job-seeker HR application database -> S - Database + S - Web application, data Personal, data_victim Other (job applicants). 154 GB volume is attacker-claimed. NAICS 926110 (national statistics agency under general economic programs); employees ~3,000. Incident March 2026 (claim/confirmation ~30 Mar; begin unknown) -> dbir 2027. The Gauteng City Region Academy claim is a separate victim and is not coded here.

summary: In late March 2026 a hacker group called XP95 claimed on Telegram to have stolen 154 GB of private and personal information from Statistics South Africa (Stats SA) and demanded a $100,000 (R1.7 million) ransom. Stats SA confirmed a breach affecting one human resources database - the online HR system used by job seekers to apply - and said it would not pay. XP95 also claimed a separate theft from the Gauteng City Region Academy.
